data.name: Associating a lookup record through an external field
data.description: In this example, Contacts is the base module's API name where AccountName is a lookup field's API name in the Contacts module. ExternalAccount_ID is the API name of the external field in the Accounts module. We will reference the external field's value in the Accounts module to create a record in the Contacts module.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a Contacts record while linking an Account lookup using an external field value.
Use for: create a contact with an account link, resolve an account by external ID, populate lookup relationships
Not supported: updating contacts, subform lookup insertion, retrieving contact records

data.name: Inserting a subform lookup record through an external field in the associated module
data.description: In this example, SubformExternal is the API name of the subform in the Contacts module. It has a look up field to the Deals module. The Deals module has an external field ExternalDeal_ID. We will reference this external field in the subform and insert a record in the Contacts module.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a Contacts record with a subform lookup linked to a Deals record through its external field value.
Use for: create a contact with subform data, link a subform entry to a deal, resolve a deal by external ID
Not supported: top-level lookup insertion, updating records, retrieving contacts

data.name: Updating a record through the external value of a lookup record in that module
data.description: In this example, Contacts is the base module and contains an account lookup field Account_Name. To update a record in the Contacts module, you must specify the external field's API name and its value in the Accounts module, and the external field's API name and its value in the Contacts module.
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates a Contacts record and its Account lookup using external field names and values.
Use for: update a contact by external value, change an account lookup, match records across modules
Not supported: creating contacts, subform updates, retrieving records

data.name: Updating a subform lookup record through an external field in the associated module
data.description: Specify the external field's API name and its value in the lookup field JSON object of the Subform.
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates a Contacts subform lookup by supplying the associated module's external field and value.
Use for: update a subform lookup, link a subform entry to an external record, revise contact subform data
Not supported: creating records, top-level lookup updates, retrieving contacts

data.name: Return historical records of commands sent to Systems Manager devices
data.description: Return historical records of commands sent to Systems Manager devices. Note that this will include the name of the Dashboard user who initiated the command if it was generated by a Dashboard admin rather than the automatic behavior of the system; you may wish to filter this out of any reports.
data.evaluateGuide:
Returns historical command records for a Systems Manager device, including the initiating Dashboard user when applicable.
Use for: audit device commands, review command history, identify command initiators
Not supported: sending commands, device performance metrics, network connection logs
